v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Ingréssa Agnes * turpitúdinis locum, Angelum Dómini præparátum invénit.
text.en: Agnes entered * the place of shame, and found the Angel of the Lord ready.

text.la: Mecum enim hábeo * custódem córporis mei, Angelum Dómini.
text.en: For I have with me * an Angel of the Lord to keep my body.

text.la: Anulo suo * subarrhávit me Dóminus meus Iesus Christus, et tamquam sponsam decorávit me coróna.
text.en: My Lord Jesus Christ hath espoused me with His ring, * and hath set on my head a crown as the crown of a bride.

text.la: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Iesu Christi, quia per Fílium tuum ignis exstínctus est a látere meo.
text.en: I bless thee, O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, because through thy Son the fire is quenched around me.

text.la: Congaudéte mecum * et congratulámini, quia cum his ómnibus lúcidas sedes accépi.
text.en: Rejoice with me * and make merry, because I also have received a throne in light among all these.

text.la: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Rex, et collaudábo te Deum Salvatórem meum. Confitébor nómini tuo: quóniam adiútor et protéctor factus es mihi, et liberásti corpus meum a perditióne.
text.en: I will give glory to thee, O Lord, O King, and I will praise thee, O God my Saviour. I will give glory to thy name: for thou hast been a helper and protector to me, and hast preserved my body from destruction.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Ecce, quod concupívi, * iam vídeo: quod sperávi, iam téneo: ipsi sum iuncta in cælis, quem in terris pósita, tota devotióne diléxi.
text.en: Behold, now I see that * which I have desired; now I possess that for which I have hoped now am I united in heaven to Him Whom I loved with my whole heart upon earth.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui infírma mundi éligis, ut fórtia quæque confúndas: concéde propítius; ut, qui beátæ Agnétis Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ solémnia cólimus, eius apud te patrocínia sentiámus.
text.en: O Almighty and everlasting God, Who hast chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty, mercifully grant unto us that we who keep the solemn feast of thy blessed Virgin and Martyr Agnes, may feel the power of her intercession with thee.
